fields.notes: AXI4-Stream's protocol-level DFT surface is the observability of the T-signals and the checkable handshake/byte-type/framing/routing rules. There is no in-band register access (the interface is addressless); chip-level scan/BIST remain device/SoC concerns.
fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)

in_band_test_facilities.name: Handshake observability
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: TVALID/TREADY timing is observable for bring-up and protocol checking.

in_band_test_facilities.name: TLAST / packet observability
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Packet boundaries are observable; mismatches flag framing errors.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Byte-type observability
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: TKEEP/TSTRB encode data/position/null; the illegal combination is detectable.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Routing observability
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: TID/TDEST expose stream id and destination for routing/ordering checks.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Protocol assertions / VIP
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: AXI4-Stream verification IP and assertions check handshake and byte-type legality.

out_of_band_test_facilities: Simulation BFMs / AXI4-Stream verification IP and protocol checkers.
On-chip logic-analyzer capture of the T-signals.
